args.sql:
WITH artifact_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ar."ART_link",
        ar."HIST_sign",
        ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score'::text AS research_score,
        ar."rating_profile"->>'cultural_score'::text AS cultural_score,
        ac."conserve_status",
        sd."env_handling_sensitivity"
    FROM "ArtifactRatings" ar
    JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON ar."ART_link" = ac."ARTregID"
    LEFT JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON ar."ART_link" = sd."ART_link"
),
conservation_value AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        CASE 
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Excellent' THEN 1
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Good' THEN 3
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Fair' THEN 5
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Poor' THEN 7
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Critical' THEN 10
            ELSE 5
        END AS conserve_val
    FROM artifact_data
),
sensitivity_values AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        CASE 
            WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'display') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE 
                    WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'display')::text = '"Low"' THEN 1
                    WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'display')::text = '"Medium"' THEN 5
                    WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'display')::text = '"High"' THEN 10
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS display_val,
        CASE 
            WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'storage') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE 
                    WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'storage')::text = '"Low"' THEN 1
                    WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'storage')::text = '"Medium"' THEN 5
                    WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'storage')::text = '"High"' THEN 10
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            ELSE NULL
        END AS storage_val
    FROM conservation_value
)
SELECT AVG(CAST(research_score AS numeric)), AVG(CAST(cultural_score AS numeric)) FROM sensitivity_values LIMIT 1;

WITH artifact_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ar."ART_link",
        CAST(ar."HIST_sign" AS numeric) AS hist_sign,
        CAST(ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score' AS numeric) AS research_score,
        CAST(ar."rating_profile"->>'cultural_score' AS numeric) AS cultural_score,
        ac."conserve_status",
        sd."env_handling_sensitivity"
    FROM "ArtifactRatings" ar
    JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON ar."ART_link" = ac."ARTregID"
    LEFT JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON ar."ART_link" = sd."ART_link"
),
with_conserve_val AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        CASE 
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Excellent' THEN 1
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Good' THEN 3
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Fair' THEN 5
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Poor' THEN 7
            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Critical' THEN 10
            ELSE 5
        END AS conserve_val
    FROM artifact_data
),
with_cpi AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ((hist_sign + COALESCE(research_score, 0) + COALESCE(cultural_score, 0)) * (10 - conserve_val)) / 30.0 AS cpi
    FROM with_conserve_val
),
with_erf AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        (
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'display') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'display')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'storage') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'context', 'storage')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'biological', 'pest') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'biological', 'pest')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'light') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'light')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'humidity') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'humidity')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'vibration') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'vibration')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'pollutants') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'pollutants')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'temperature') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'environment', 'temperature')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'handling_transport', 'handling') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'handling_transport', 'handling')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE WHEN jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'handling_transport', 'transport') IS NOT NULL 
                THEN CASE jsonb_extract_path("env_handling_sensitivity", 'handling_transport', 'transport')::text
                    WHEN '"Low"' THEN 1 WHEN '"Medium"' THEN 5 WHEN '"High"' THEN 10 END END, 0)
        ) / 10.0 AS erf
    FROM with_cpi
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cpi * erf)::numeric, 2) AS overall_risk_score FROM with_erf;

WITH artifact_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ar."ART_link",
        CAST(ar."HIST_sign" AS numeric) AS hist_sign,
        CAST(ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score' AS numeric) AS research_score,
        CAST(ar."rating_profile"->>'cultural_score' AS numeric) AS cultural_score,
        ac."conserve_status",
        sd."env_handling_sensitivity"
